body: When a prior operation acknowledgement is missing, support must inspect the operation record before retrying. A committed operation must not be repeated. An unknown outcome must be escalated rather than duplicated.

Current access policy. Starter includes base_access. Team includes base_access, collaboration and exports. Business includes all Team features plus admin_controls. Entitlement reconciliation requires an authorised requester, an unexpired applicable approval, the current subscription revision and idempotent execution.
